release_notes:
Fix: Zelle auto-credit can't recognize a customer by email-address memo, or credit a deposit with no matching invoice

The memo-matching regex only recognized username-shaped tokens
([A-Za-z0-9_.-]); an "@" (as in any email address) fell outside that
character class, so a customer writing their account email in the Zelle
memo instead of their username was never matched at all, even when that
email is an exact, unambiguous identifier.

Separately, the reconciler could only ever apply an incoming deposit to
an invoice that already existed as "pending" -- if a customer Zelles
money without first starting an Add Funds request on the site, there was
nothing to match it to regardless of memo quality, and the deposit sat
uncredited indefinitely.

Candidate extraction now also pulls out email-shaped tokens from the memo,
and the user lookup checks UserEmail (case-insensitive) alongside
UserName. When a memo gives an exact email match but the user has no
pending invoice at that amount, the reconciler now creates one and
credits it immediately, the same way an admin would if they noticed the
deposit by hand -- gated on the stronger "exact email match" signal
specifically, and still subject to the existing duplicate-settlement
guard so an already-accounted-for payment can't be credited twice.
